name: M2 sweep resume
command: cd /home/z/vibe/pathlm && export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True && for name in I4 C2 L1 L3 L4; do echo "=== $name start $(date +%H:%M:%S) ===" >> .scratch/06-m2-sweep/evidence/runner.log; python3 train_m1.py "$name" --config "configs/$name.json" --out-root .scratch/06-m2-sweep/evidence >> ".scratch/06-m2-sweep/evidence/${name}_stdout.log" 2>&1; echo "=== $name exit $? $(date +%H:%M:%S) ===" >> .scratch/06-m2-sweep/evidence/runner.log; done; echo "ALL DONE $(date)" >> .scratch/06-m2-sweep/evidence/runner.log
